The (u1, key_lost) self-loop is unreachable (entering u1 requires picking up the ball with empty hands, so has_door_key was false), which is harmless. (4) Irrelevant events: every state has a per-state else self-loop, so conditions like has_door_key in u0/u2/u3, door re-openings in u3, and blocker_moved re-firings are all absorbed safely; door/ball regressions need no explicit RM regression because the physics prevents door_open while the ball is back and re-opening the door in u3 yields no reward. (5) Reward safety: each progress transition moves to a state with no return path, so 0.1/0.1/0.2/1.0 are each collected at most once (bounded total 1.4), progress reward is dense across all four stages, and penalties are small per-violation amounts. (6) Labels on overlapping steps are mutually exclusive (key_lost excludes has_door_key and door_open by definition; target_picked_up excludes key_lost and has_door_key), so no ambiguous competing transitions. Minor note: zero-reward else self-loops are omitted from REWARD_FUNCTION, which is acceptable under the default-0 convention.
